lines: +# Cross-tokenizer OPD teacher scoring
+What was wrong with the ported single-turn code on our multi-turn episodes:
+- It rendered only the messages before the first assistant turn with the teacher's template and then appended
+  `sample.response` — the student's own ChatML/think/tool-call scaffolding for every later turn — so the teacher
+  never judged the conversation in its own format beyond turn 1. It also sent `text` (server-side tokenization can
+  differ from the locally computed prompt length) and aligned per-token *decoded strings*, which breaks when a
+  token splits a multi-byte character and never resyncs after the first scaffolding difference.
+- It treated any run with `teacher_tokenizer_path` as cross-vocab, so naming today's Qwen3.5-9B in a YAML would
+  silently change its scoring.
+What the hooks do now (`examples/terminal_opd/teacher_scoring.py`, small change in `reward.py`):
+- `is_cross_vocab` compares the named teacher's vocabulary (incl. added tokens) with the student's. Same-vocab
+  teachers keep the legacy Miles path bit-for-bit (verified: YAML and no-YAML replays produce identical
+  `teacher_log_probs`); only genuinely different tokenizers take the new path.
+- The whole episode (`metadata["messages"]` + `metadata["tools"]` + the YAML chat-template kwargs) is rendered
+  once with the teacher's chat template, tokenized locally, and scored via `input_ids` with
+  `logprob_start_len=0`. Samples without stored messages keep the old prompt-plus-response behaviour.
+- Alignment is at the byte level. Per assistant turn (from `loss_mask` runs), the pieces the student wrote —
+  reasoning, content, tool-call names, argument keys/values (incl. JSON-escaped forms on the teacher side) —
+  are located in both token streams, with a bounded byte diff filling shared scaffolding between them. A student
+  token gets the teacher's log-prob only when the teacher contains exactly the same token bytes at the
+  corresponding offset; everything else keeps the student's rollout log-prob (no signal). That covers, per design:
+  reasoning the teacher's template drops from history (e.g. non-final turns for Qwen3/Falcon), student XML
+  tool-call scaffolding when the teacher renders JSON calls, template-fabricated closings on truncated turns,
+  and token-boundary mismatches. Unrenderable episodes and teacher failures also degrade to no signal instead
+  of failing the rollout.
+- Verdict rewards and the hook interface are unchanged.
+Verification: `examples/terminal_opd/test_teacher_scoring.py` (run with
+`PYTHONPATH=/app/miles python3 examples/terminal_opd/test_teacher_scoring.py` from `/app/miles`), full
+`replay_opd.py` runs over all three dumps against fake Qwen3-8B/Falcon teachers, exact same-tokenizer parity
+checks, and spot checks against the live Falcon-H1R-7B server. Live run: see below.
